children: Apogee Enterprises agreed to acquire GroGlass, which makes anti-reflective coatings for glass and acrylic, for up to $72.5 million.
The deal includes up to $11.6 million in milestone payments for reaching certain financial targets over three years, the company said Wednesday.
The acquisition is expected to add about $30 million in revenue in the first 12 months and is expected to close in Apogee's fiscal third quarter.

GroGlass, based in Latvia, has a portfolio that includes premium brands recognized for superior optical clarity and durability, serving customers across global end markets such as museums, electronics, and architectural design, Apogee said.
Apogee said GroGlass will be integrated into its Performance Surfaces segment and enhance its coatings and materials science capabilities.
